digest.component_or_area: review-bot comment-added webhook and eligibility gate
propositions: A contributor comment containing the word 'recheck-review' on a change with a current-revision coverage-gap or escalated retry tag resets the attempts budget, enqueues a forced re-review via existing machinery, and posts a queued reply without writing a vote label.

A recheck-review comment on a change carrying a real BLOCK finding (both bare and merge-change forms) is refused server-side without resetting budget or enqueueing, posting a refusal reply and emitting a greppable log marker.

The tag eligibility classifier parses all three production tag shapes—_TAG_SUFFIXES vocabulary, hardcoded merge-review literal, and in-bracket merge-change suffix—and treats unparseable or absent tags as eligible (fail-open to fail-closed review).
The reply path posts a Gerrit message containing only a message body with no labels key, ensuring no vote label write or displacement.
The /rerun operator endpoint is harmonized to reset the attempts budget before enqueueing, matching the contributor trigger semantics.
Bot-authored comments and non-matching tokens are silent no-ops; a fresh review enqueued through this path may flip a PASS or vote-less state to BLOCK, which is fail-closed-safe.
